title: Biddable Media Manager - Paid Social & PPC
description:
Location: Norwich / Hybrid

Brand: Anglian Home Improvements (part of ASHI Group)

ASHI Group is the UK's largest home improvement organisation, home to leading brands Anglian Home Improvements, Everest and Safestyle. With all products manufactured in our Norwich factory, we deliver premium windows, doors and conservatories to homeowners nationwide.

We are now recruiting an experienced Biddable Manager to take ownership of our Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) activity in-house and support wider PPC and Performance Marketing across multiple national brands. This is a rare opportunity to manage large-scale budgets and drive high-quality lead generation at volume.

What you'll be doing
- Lead and optimise Paid Social campaigns across three national brands with a focus on ROI, CPA and lead quality.
- Work with significant eight-figure budgets across platforms including Meta, Google Ads and Microsoft Ads .
- Develop data-driven audience strategies, including first-party data, and guide creative best practice to scale performance.
- Collaborate with internal teams to brief and optimise bespoke landing pages for maximum conversion.
- Manage bids using automated bidding strategies tied to offline conversion events.
- Engage with digital agencies, tech providers and media owners (Google, Meta, Microsoft) to leverage cutting-edge tools and insights.
- Work hands-on with Google Marketing Platform (CM, SA360, DV360), GA4, Bing Ads, and other Martech solutions.
- Report to the Biddable Media Lead, ensuring all activity aligns with the wider paid media strategy.
- Partner with Digital, Marketing, Sales and NCCC teams to deliver lead targets and revenue.
- Stay ahead of industry trends through ongoing learning, conferences and training.

About you
- 2-4 years' hands-on experience managing large Paid Social campaigns.
- Strong analytical skills and a proactive, results-driven approach.
- Digital marketing background (agency or client side).
- Highly organised, calm under pressure and confident communicating performance insights.
- Experience in lead generation, Google Ads/Microsoft Ads, GMP or Meta Blueprint is an advantage.

Why Join Us:
- Competitive Salary
- 31 days holiday, increasing to 33 days after 2 years of service plus have your birthday off
- Hybrid working, 2 days each week in the office and the rest working from home
- Pension - with up to 4 x salary & income protection, with the option to potentially save on tax and National Insurance via our salary sacrifice arrangement
- Salary sacrifice benefits - enjoy perks such as pension, cycle to work, electric car purchase, and additional annual leave, while potentially reducing your tax and NI contributions
- Heavily discounted group discount scheme on all products
- Group Perks and freebies on days out, cinema, theatre, eating in and out, mobiles phones, a new car, food shopping and most major high street retailers
- Opportunity to work with a forward-thinking and supportive team.
- Career development and continuous learning opportunities.

Join us and be a part of our success story. Apply now to make an impact in the world of digital marketing!

Our Company is committed to monitoring & aligning its Policies with up-to-date Government guidance on reducing the spread of respiratory infections in the workplace. Through the Company's value of "Succeed Together" we are committed to Equality, Diversity and Inclusion. We recruit the 'best person for the job' regardless of any protected characteristics as defined by the Equality Act 2010 creating an inclusive working environment and culture for our employees.

title: Brand Manager
description:
Your Company:
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Brand Manager to join a growing and innovative organisation at a pivotal stage of its journey. Based in Norwich with a hybrid working arrangement, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of a customer-focused brand, helping to create meaningful experiences that resonate with customers whilst supporting ambitious growth plans.
Working closely with a range of departments across the business, you will play a key role in developing and delivering brand initiatives that strengthen customer engagement, drive commercial performance and ensure a consistent and compelling brand presence across all channels.

Your Role:
While in this position your duties may include but will not be limited to:
- Leading the development and delivery of the organisation's brand strategy and growth plans
- Ensuring a consistent, engaging and high-quality brand experience across all customer touchpoints
- Translating brand strategy into actionable plans, campaigns and initiatives that support wider business objectives
- Managing multi-channel marketing and brand activity to maximise customer engagement and brand awareness
- Overseeing content creation and messaging across digital, CRM, customer communications and marketing channels
- Supporting the ongoing evolution of brand positioning, identity and proposition to meet changing customer needs
- Using customer insight, market trends and performance data to inform decision-making and optimise brand performance
- Working collaboratively with sales, customer service, digital, e-commerce, CRM and development teams to deliver joined-up customer experiences
- Managing project timelines, budgets and priorities to ensure successful campaign delivery
- Line managing and developing junior team members, providing guidance, coaching and support
- Monitoring brand performance and making recommendations to improve customer perception, engagement and commercial outcomes
- Acting as a key point of contact for brand-related projects, challenges and opportunities across the business

What You Will Need To Apply:
- A minimum of 3-5 years' experience within a Brand Manager or similar brand-focused position
- Previous experience delivering successful multi-channel brand campaigns and initiatives
- Experience working within consumer, direct-to-consumer, subscription-based or service-led organisations
- Strong understanding of brand development, customer journeys and marketing best practice
- Proven ability to collaborate effectively with multiple departments and stakeholders
- Excellent organisational and project management skills
- Strong commercial awareness with the ability to link brand activity to business performance
- Experience using customer insight, analytics and performance data to support decision-making
- Excellent communication skills with strong attention to detail and messaging consistency
- Degree qualification or equivalent experience within Marketing, Branding, Design, Digital Media or a related discipline
- A proactive, customer-focused and results-driven approach

It Would Be Beneficial If You Also Have:
- Experience within a regulated, healthcare, care, financial services or trust-based environment
- Previous involvement in brand repositioning, proposition development or business transformation projects
- Experience managing direct reports and supporting team development
- Exposure to customer advocacy, referral programmes, influencer marketing or partnership initiatives
- Knowledge of SEO, content strategy, performance marketing or experimentation frameworks
- Understanding of emerging digital trends, including AI-assisted search and customer discovery behaviours
- Additional training in brand strategy, customer experience, behavioural science or customer insight

What You Will Receive in Return:
This organisation is undergoing an exciting period of growth and transformation, creating a unique opportunity for a talented Brand Manager to make a lasting impact on the future direction of the business.
The successful candidate will receive a salary of up to £50,000, dependent upon previous experience and relevant knowledge. In addition, the company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your professional development and personal wellbeing.
You will have the opportunity to work alongside senior stakeholders, influence key business decisions and help shape a brand that customers genuinely trust and connect with.
As well as this, there are excellent opportunities for career progression, ongoing learning and personal development, allowing you to further enhance your expertise within a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

To investigate this role further, please do not hesitate to contact:

Suzi Kocovska - Recruitment Partner

title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Location: Office-based, initially in Dereham, with the option to work from another Sowerbys office by agreement. Occasional travel across Norfolk is required.

Reports to: Marketing Director

Salary: Negotiable

Hours: Full-time

Sowerbys is one of Norfolk's leading independent estate agents. We're looking for a commercially minded Senior Digital Marketing Specialist with extensive hands-on Meta advertising experience to take ownership of our digital marketing across residential sales, lettings and new homes.

You'll understand what works across paid and organic social media - and why. You'll plan campaigns, analyse performance and audience behaviour, and turn those insights into commercial recommendations that improve results.

Creativity is equally important. You'll develop engaging campaigns, content and video ideas while ensuring everything we produce feels unmistakably Sowerbys.

Working closely with our Marketing Director, you'll lead the day-to-day delivery of our digital activity and line manage one member of the digital marketing team. You'll also collaborate with our wider Marketing and Visual Media team to deliver joined-up campaigns that build our brand, generate high-quality enquiries and produce measurable results.

What you'll be doing:
- Taking ownership of Sowerbys' digital marketing activity and helping shape its direction.
- Planning, building and managing paid social campaigns, particularly through Meta Ads Manager.
- Managing campaign objectives, audiences, budgets, creative formats, tracking, testing, optimisation and reporting.
- Analysing paid and organic social performance, audience behaviour, lead quality, website activity, conversions and return on investment.
- Turning data and campaign findings into clear recommendations for the Marketing Director and wider business.
- Continually testing and refining audiences, content, creative and campaign approaches.
- Planning integrated campaigns across social media, email, website and other digital channels.
- Overseeing the social media content calendar and using performance insights to guide future content.
- Writing engaging social posts, website content, blogs and emails in the Sowerbys tone of voice.
- Developing ideas, scripts and briefs for brand films, property films and social video, working with our videographers, photographers and presenters.
- Supporting improvements to website content, landing pages and customer journeys.
- Supporting our SEO strategy through keyword-led content and on-page optimisation.
- Managing email marketing and making better use of customer data and segmentation.
- Creating tailored digital plans for important residential sales, lettings and new homes opportunities, including high-value properties and key developments.
- Producing monthly performance reports, managing budgets and working with relevant agencies and suppliers.
- Line managing one team member, setting priorities, overseeing their workload and supporting their development.
- Building strong relationships with our offices and helping colleagues understand how digital marketing contributes to their success.

What we're looking for:

You'll be commercially minded, analytical and creative, with the confidence to take ownership, challenge existing approaches and make evidence-based recommendations.

You should have:
- Extensive hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, including building campaigns from the ground up, developing audiences, allocating budgets, testing creative, optimising performance and reporting results.
- A proven record of improving lead quality, cost per enquiry, conversions or return on investment through paid social campaigns.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign, social media and website data into commercial recommendations.
- A detailed understanding of audience behaviour and the content that generates engagement, enquiries and conversions.
- Experience managing organic social channels and using performance insights to guide content.
- Broad digital marketing experience across several channels. Knowledge of LinkedIn Campaign Manager and other paid platforms would be advantageous.
- Strong creative judgement and the ability to develop ideas for campaigns, property marketing and video.
- Excellent copywriting and proofreading skills, including writing scripts and creative briefs.
- A good understanding of SEO and how content, websites and search work together.
- Working knowledge of content management systems, Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
- Experience managing campaigns, budgets and deadlines, with excellent attention to detail and a genuine sense of ownership.
- The confidence to work with colleagues at every level and provide clear direction while maintaining high standards.
- Previous experience managing, supervising or developing another team member would be advantageous.
- A full UK driving licence and access to your own car, as occasional travel across Norfolk is required.
- Experience in property or another lifestyle-led brand would be useful, but isn't essential. What matters most is your ability to combine paid social expertise and intelligent performance analysis with strong creative judgement and measurable commercial results.

Why join Sowerbys?

You'll play an important role in shaping the digital presence of a well-established Norfolk brand. As part of our experienced in-house Marketing and Visual Media team, you'll have the freedom to bring forward ideas, test new approaches and create work you can genuinely be proud of.

To apply: Please send your CV with examples of paid social campaigns you have personally managed, including their objectives, your role, approach and results if appropriate. We would also welcome examples of content, writing, creative campaigns or video projects.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Are you a talented Social Media Marketing Specialist with strong experience across both B2 B and B2 C social media? A well-established and highly regarded digital marketing agency near Norwich is looking for an experienced and versatile social media professional to join their growing team - offering a fantastic hybrid role where your ability to switch between business and consumer audiences will be genuinely valued.

The Role
As Social Media Marketing Specialist, you'll take the lead on planning, creating, and delivering social media strategies across a diverse portfolio of clients spanning both B2 B and B2 C. You'll be equally comfortable crafting professional, authority-building content for business audiences on LinkedIn as you are creating bold, engaging, and creative content that captures attention on TikTok. Alongside your organic social expertise, you'll also bring solid experience of paid social - using data and insight to drive measurable results for clients across the full spectrum of their social media presence.

Key Responsibilities
- Developing and implementing tailored social media strategies for both B2 B and B2 C clients, aligned to their individual objectives, audiences, and brand voice
- Planning and managing content calendars across multiple platforms, ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery for all client accounts
- Creating compelling content for LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X (Twitter), adapting tone, format, and style to suit each platform and audience
- Planning, managing, and optimising paid social campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant platforms
- Monitoring, analysing, and reporting on both organic and paid social performance, translating data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
- Developing thought leadership and professional content strategies for B2 B clients alongside creative, high-impact consumer campaigns for B2 C clients
- Building strong client relationships, presenting strategies and performance reports with confidence and clarity
- Staying ahead of platform updates, algorithm changes, and emerging social media trends - particularly across LinkedIn and TikTok
- Collaborating with wider agency teams including content, design, SEO, and PPC to ensure an integrated approach to client campaigns

What We're Looking For
- Proven experience in a social media marketing role covering both B2 B and B2 C - agency experience is highly desirable
- Strong, hands-on experience of LinkedIn and TikTok - both organic content and paid advertising on these platforms is essential
- Solid experience managing paid social campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, and Meta Ads
- A good understanding of the B2 B buyer journey alongside a flair for creative, consumer-focused content and campaigns
- Proficient with social media management and scheduling tools such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Buffer, or similar
- Excellent written and creative communication skills with the ability to adapt tone, style, and format across very different brands and audiences
- A data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret performance metrics and demonstrate clear ROI to clients
- Strong client management and presentation skills
- Based within commuting distance of Norwich for hybrid working requirements

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £40,000 depending on experience
- Hybrid working arrangement offering a great balance between office and home working
- A creative, collaborative agency environment with a varied and exciting mix of B2 B and B2 C clients
- Genuine opportunities for career development and progression
- The chance to work across a broad and diverse client portfolio with a talented, ambitious team

How to Apply
If you're an experienced Social Media Marketing Specialist with a strong grasp of both B2 B and B2 C social media - and the LinkedIn and TikTok expertise to match - we'd love to hear from you. Apply now with your up-to-date CV and one of our consultants will be in touch to discuss the opportunity in more detail.
